exercises.instructions: Choose the correct verb form to complete each sentence.

questions.question: You ________ in the river yesterday.
questions.explanation: "Yesterday" indicates past time, so use the past form "swam". မနေ့ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် V2 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: You ________ tomorrow.
questions.explanation: "Tomorrow" indicates future time, so use "will + V1". မနက်ဖန်ဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် will + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She ________ me.
questions.explanation: The context indicates past time, so use the past form "knew". အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် V2 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She ________ me.
questions.explanation: The context indicates future time, so use "will + V1". အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် will + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: It ________ five minutes ago.
questions.explanation: "Five minutes ago" indicates past time, so use the past form "rained". ငါးမိနစ်ကဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် V2 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: It ________ tomorrow morning.
questions.explanation: "Tomorrow morning" indicates future time, so use "will + V1". မနက်ဖန်မနက်ခင်ဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် will + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: They ________ three years ago.
questions.explanation: "Three years ago" indicates past time, so use the past form "lived". သုံးနှစ်ကဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် V2 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: They ________ next year.
questions.explanation: "Next year" indicates future time, so use "will + V1". နောင်နှစ်ဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် will + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: We ________ every Sunday.
questions.explanation: Negative Simple Present uses "don't + V1". Simple Present ရဲ့ ငြင်းဆိုချက်မှာ don't + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: ________ go to the park every Sunday?
questions.explanation: Simple Present interrogative uses "Do + subject + V1". Simple Present ရဲ့ မေးခွန်းမှာ Do + subject + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: We ________.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense of "go" is "went". go ရဲ့ V2 က went ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: Didn't we ________?
questions.explanation: After "Didn't", use the base form (V1). Didn't ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: We ________.
questions.explanation: Simple Future negative uses "won't + V1". Simple Future ရဲ့ ငြင်းဆိုချက်မှာ won't + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Won't ________?
options: we go to the park next month
we went to the park next month
we will go to the park next month
questions.answer: we go to the park next month
questions.explanation: After "Won't", use the base form (V1). Won't ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: He ________.
questions.explanation: Simple Present with "he" uses "V1 + s". he နဲ့ Simple Present မှာ V1 + s ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Does he ________?
questions.explanation: After "Does", use the base form (V1). Does ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: He ________.
questions.explanation: Simple Past negative uses "didn't + V1". Simple Past ရဲ့ ငြင်းဆိုချက်မှာ didn't + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Didn't he ________?
options: live in Yangon three years ago
lived in Yangon three years ago
will live in Yangon three years ago
questions.answer: live in Yangon three years ago
questions.explanation: After "Didn't", use the base form (V1). Didn't ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: He ________.
questions.explanation: Simple Future negative uses "won't + V1". Simple Future ရဲ့ ငြင်းဆိုချက်မှာ won't + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Will ________?
options: he live in Yangon next year
he lives in Yangon next year
he lived in Yangon next year
questions.answer: he live in Yangon next year
questions.explanation: After "Will", use the base form (V1). Will ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Won't ________?
options: he live in Yangon next year
he lives in Yangon next year
he lived in Yangon next year
questions.answer: he live in Yangon next year
questions.explanation: After "Won't", use the base form (V1). Won't ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: No, ________.
questions.explanation: Short negative answer for Simple Present. Simple Present ရဲ့ အတိုချုပ် ငြင်းဆိုချက်ပါ။

questions.question: No, ________.
options: we don't go to the park every Sunday
we didn't go to the park every Sunday
we won't go to the park every Sunday
questions.answer: we don't go to the park every Sunday
questions.explanation: Long negative answer for Simple Present. Simple Present ရဲ့ အရှည် ငြင်းဆိုချက်ပါ။

questions.question: Yes, ________.
questions.explanation: Short positive answer for Simple Past. Simple Past ရဲ့ အတိုချုပ် ဖြေကြားချက်ပါ။

questions.question: Yes, ________.
options: we will go to the park
questions.explanation: Long positive answer for Simple Past. Simple Past ရဲ့ အရှည် ဖြေကြားချက်ပါ။

questions.question: Yes, ________.
questions.explanation: Short positive answer for Simple Future. Simple Future ရဲ့ အတိုချုပ် ဖြေကြားချက်ပါ။

questions.question: No, ________.
options: we don't go to the park next month
we didn't go to the park next month
we won't go to the park next month
questions.answer: we won't go to the park next month
questions.explanation: Long negative answer for Simple Future. Simple Future ရဲ့ အရှည် ငြင်းဆိုချက်ပါ။

questions.question: Yes, ________.
questions.explanation: Short positive answer for Simple Present with "he". he နဲ့ Simple Present ရဲ့ အတိုချုပ် ဖြေကြားချက်ပါ။

questions.question: Yes, ________.
questions.explanation: Long positive answer for Simple Present with "he". he နဲ့ Simple Present ရဲ့ အရှည် ဖြေကြားချက်ပါ။

questions.question: No, ________.
questions.explanation: Short negative answer for Simple Past with "he". he နဲ့ Simple Past ရဲ့ အတိုချုပ် ငြင်းဆိုချက်ပါ။

questions.question: No, ________.
options: he doesn't live in Yangon three years ago
he didn't live in Yangon three years ago
he won't live in Yangon three years ago
questions.answer: he didn't live in Yangon three years ago
questions.explanation: Long negative answer for Simple Past with "he". he နဲ့ Simple Past ရဲ့ အရှည် ငြင်းဆိုချက်ပါ။

questions.question: Yes, ________.
questions.explanation: Short positive answer for Simple Future with "he". he နဲ့ Simple Future ရဲ့ အတိုချုပ် ဖြေကြားချက်ပါ။

questions.question: No, ________.
questions.explanation: Short negative answer for Simple Future with "he". he နဲ့ Simple Future ရဲ့ အတိုချုပ် ငြင်းဆိုချက်ပါ။

questions.question: Yes, ________.
options: he lives in Yangon next year
he lived in Yangon next year
he will live in Yangon next year
questions.answer: he will live in Yangon next year
questions.explanation: Long positive answer for Simple Future with "he". he နဲ့ Simple Future ရဲ့ အရှည် ဖြေကြားချက်ပါ။

questions.question: No, ________.
options: he doesn't live in Yangon next year
he didn't live in Yangon next year
he won't live in Yangon next year
questions.answer: he won't live in Yangon next year
questions.explanation: Long negative answer for Simple Future with "he". he နဲ့ Simple Future ရဲ့ အရှည် ငြင်းဆိုချက်ပါ။

questions.question: They (gone, went, go) to Bagan last month.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense of 'go' is 'went'. 'last month' indicates past time. ပြီးခဲ့တဲ့လဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် V2 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: You (will stay, stayed, stay) at Mandalay next month.
questions.explanation: 'next month' indicates future time, so we use 'will + V1'. လာမယ့်လဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် will + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She doesn't (talk, taught, talks) loudly.
questions.explanation: After 'doesn't', we use the base form of the verb (V1). doesn't ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Her brother (worked, works, worker) all the time.
questions.explanation: Simple Present tense with 'he' (her brother) uses 'V1 + s'. he နဲ့ Simple Present မှာ V1 + s ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Do you think he will (remember, remembering, remembered) you?
questions.explanation: After 'will', we use the base form of the verb (V1). will ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I always (ski, skiing, skies) in the winter.
questions.explanation: Simple Present tense with 'I' uses the base form of the verb. I နဲ့ Simple Present မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She won't (love, loves, loved) him.
questions.explanation: After 'won't', we use the base form of the verb (V1). won't ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: (Do, Does, Did) she cry yesterday?
questions.explanation: 'yesterday' indicates past time, so we use 'Did'. မနေ့ကဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် Did ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: You can (did, does, do) it.
questions.explanation: After modal verbs like 'can', we use the base form of the verb. can လိုမတူတူကွဲတဲ့ကြောင်းတွေပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Don't you (forgot, forget, forgotten) your guitar?
questions.explanation: After 'Don't', we use the base form of the verb (V1). Don't ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: (Do, Does, Did) you like fizzy drinks?
questions.explanation: Simple Present tense with 'you' uses 'Do'. you နဲ့ Simple Present မှာ Do ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: (Working, Worked, Work) in a small group and discuss your answers.
questions.explanation: Imperative form uses the base form of the verb. အမိန့်ပေးသည့်ပုံစံမှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She (love, loved, loves) Greek Yoghurt.
questions.explanation: Simple Present tense with 'she' uses 'V1 + s'. she နဲ့ Simple Present မှာ V1 + s ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: The fans (met, meets, meeting) the star outside the cinema last night.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense of 'meet' is 'met'. 'last night' indicates past time. မနေ့ညကဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် V2 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I (hated, hate, hates) washing dishes.
questions.explanation: Simple Present tense with 'I' uses the base form of the verb. I နဲ့ Simple Present မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Yesterday afternoon my sister (make, makes, made) a chocolate cake.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense of 'make' is 'made'. 'Yesterday afternoon' indicates past time. မနေ့ညနေကဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် V2 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Susan (wears, wore, worn) a new dress to the party last weekend.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense of 'wear' is 'wore'. 'last weekend' indicates past time. ပြီးခဲ့တဲ့အပတ်ကဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် V2 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: James and Alice (plays, will play, play) football next Sunday.
questions.explanation: 'next Sunday' indicates future time, so we use 'will + V1'. လာမယ့်တနင်္ဂနွေဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် will + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: Polar bears (will disappear, disappear, disappeared) soon.
questions.explanation: 'soon' indicates future time, so we use 'will + V1'. မကြာခင်ဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် will + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: (Did, Do, Does) you see the new TV series last night?
questions.explanation: 'last night' indicates past time, so we use 'Did'. မနေ့ညကဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် Did ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I am taking an umbrella because the weather forecast said that it (rains, rained, will rain) later.
questions.explanation: 'later' indicates future time, so we use 'will + V1'. နောက်ပိုင်းဆိုတာ အနာဂတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် will + V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I (see, saw, seeing) an eagle while I was walking in the mountains.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense of 'see' is 'saw'. see ရဲ့ V2 က saw ဖြစ်ပါတယ်။

questions.question: It (increased, increase, increases) your vocabularies.
questions.explanation: Simple Present tense with 'it' uses 'V1 + s'. it နဲ့ Simple Present မှာ V1 + s ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I (like, likes, liked) coffee when I was 11.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense because 'when I was 11' indicates past time. ကျွန်မ ၁၁ နှစ်အရွယ်ကဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် V2 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I didn't (do, does, doing) sport last weekend.
questions.explanation: After 'didn't', we use the base form of the verb (V1). didn't ပြီးနောက်မှာ V1 ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: ကျယ် မင်းကို ယုံတယ်။ (I / you / believe in)
questions.explanation: Simple Present tense: Subject + V1 + object. Simple Present ပုံစံ - Subject + V1 + object.

questions.question: မင်း ငါ့ကို ကူညီမလား။ (you / me / help)
questions.explanation: The Burmese ending "မလား" indicates a future question. မြန်မာစကား "မလား" က အနာဂတ်မေးခွန်းကိုဖော်ပြတယ်။

questions.question: သူမ မနက်ဖန် ကျောင်းသို့ သွားမှာမယ်။ (She / tomorrow / go to school)
options: She will go to school tomorrow.
questions.answer: She will go to school tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Simple Future tense: Subject + will + V1. "Tomorrow" and "မှာမယ်" indicate future. Simple Future ပုံစံ - Subject + will + V1.

questions.question: သူ ငါ့ကို မမှတ်မိခဲ့ပါ။ (He / me / forgot)
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense negative: Subject + didn't + V1. "ခဲ့ပါ။" indicates past. Simple Past ငြင်းဆိုပုံ - Subject + didn't + V1.

questions.question: မင်းတို့ ပန်းကန် မဆေးဘူးလား။ (you / wash the dishes)
questions.explanation: Simple Present tense negative question: Don't + subject + V1? "ဘူးလား" indicates a negative question in present. Simple Present ငြင်းဆိုမေးခွန်း - Don't + subject + V1?

questions.question: မနေ့က သူမ အဝတ်တွေ မညှစ်တက်ခဲ့လား။ (she / yesterday / iron the clothes)
options: Does she iron the clothes yesterday?
Did she iron the clothes yesterday?
Will she iron the clothes yesterday?
questions.answer: Did she iron the clothes yesterday?
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense question: Did + subject + V1? "မနေ့က" indicates past. Simple Past မေးခွန်း - Did + subject + V1?

questions.question: သူမ မင်းရဲ့ပန်းသီး ကို စားမှာ မဟုတ်ဘူး။ (She / eat / your apples)
questions.explanation: Simple Future tense negative: Subject + won't + V1. "မှာ မဟုတ်ဘူး" indicates future negative. Simple Future ငြင်းဆိုပုံ - Subject + won't + V1.

questions.question: သူ ဂျာမနီမှာ မနေဘူး မဟုတ်လား။ (he / in Germany / live)
questions.explanation: Simple Present tense negative question: Doesn't + subject + V1? "ဘူးလား" indicates a negative question in present. Simple Present ငြင်းဆိုမေးခွန်း - Doesn't + subject + V1?

questions.question: သူမက အင်္ဂလိပ်သဒ္ဒါကို တခြားသူတွေနဲ့ မျှဝတယ်။ (She / English grammar / share / to other)
options: She shares English grammar with others.
She shared English grammar with others.
She will share English grammar with others.
questions.answer: She shares English grammar with others.
questions.explanation: Simple Present tense: Subject + V1 + s. "တယ်" indicates present. Simple Present ပုံစံ - Subject + V1 + s.

questions.question: သူတို့ ဒီနေ့ အတန်းမတက်ခဲ့ဘူး။ (They / today / attend the class)
options: They don't attend the class today.
They didn't attend the class today.
They won't attend the class today.
questions.answer: They didn't attend the class today.
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense negative: Subject + didn't + V1. "ခဲ့ဘူး" indicates past negative. Simple Past ငြင်းဆိုပုံ - Subject + didn't + V1.

questions.question: ငါတို့ မင်းကို နားလည်မှားခဲ့ကတယ်။ (We / you / misunderstood)
questions.explanation: Simple Past tense: Subject + V2. "ခဲ့ကတယ်" indicates past. Simple Past ပုံစံ - Subject + V2.

questions.question: မင်း အစောရုံစောစောမထဘူးလား။ (you / get up early)
questions.explanation: Simple Present tense negative question: Don't + subject + V1? "ဘူးလား" indicates a negative question in present. Simple Present ငြင်းဆိုမေးခွန်း - Don't + subject + V1?

questions.question: မကြာခင် သူ ဘူတာကိုရောက်လာလှမ်းမှာမယ်။ (soon / he / arrive at the station)
options: He arrives at the station soon.
He arrived at the station soon.
He will arrive at the station soon.
questions.answer: He will arrive at the station soon.
questions.explanation: Simple Future tense: Subject + will + V1. "မကြာခင်" and "မှာမယ်" indicate future. Simple Future ပုံစံ - Subject + will + V1.

questions.question: သူမ သူ့ကို မချစ်ချပါဘူး။ (She / him / love)
questions.explanation: Simple Present tense negative: Subject + doesn't + V1. "ပါဘူး" indicates present negative. Simple Present ငြင်းဆိုပုံ - Subject + doesn't + V1.

questions.question: သူတို့ မနက်ဖန် ဘောလုံးကန်ကြလှမ်းမှာမယ်။ (They / tomorrow / play the football)
questions.explanation: Simple Future tense: Subject + will + V1. "မနက်ဖန်" and "မှာမယ်" indicate future. Simple Future ပုံစံ - Subject + will + V1.
